text: The National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (LSM) initiative in South Korea is a comprehensive program aimed at identifying and mitigating the risks of rainfall-induced landslides. It integrates machine learning-based susceptibility modeling with the Korea Forest Service's operational forecasting to provide daily national susceptibility maps and short-term early warnings. The initiative is part of a larger effort to enhance landslide forecasting and information services in South Korea, leveraging academic, industry, and government partnerships to improve spatial and temporal resolution in landslide risk assessment.
